_comment: FICTIONAL sample data for layout testing only. Not a real procedure for any machine.
shutdown_procedure: Normal stop per operator work instruction WI-PROD-0000 (sample reference).
group_lockout: Sample text: each authorized employee applies a personal lock to the group lockbox.
restart_steps: Sample step: confirm all tools removed and guards replaced
Sample step: remove safety blocks from platen
Sample step: open valves and close disconnects in reverse order of isolation
Sample step: start machine from operator station

points.label: E-1
points.device: Main disconnect, MCC-2 bucket 4, east wall behind machine (sample)
points.deenergize: Sample text: turn disconnect handle to OFF
points.lock: Apply lock and tag through disconnect handle hasp
points.stored_energy: Sample text: wait 5 minutes for VFD DC bus to discharge
points.verify: Sample text: qualified person tests for absence of voltage

points.label: E-2
points.verify: Sample text: control screen dark, UPS indicator off

points.label: P-1
points.device: ¼ turn valve located on the air/water/gas panel
points.deenergize: Confirm PSI gauge is operational, then turn valve to EXH position to drain air from valve to end of line
points.verify: Monitor PSI gauge until 0 PSI is observed

points.label: H-1
points.device: Hydraulic isolation valve HV-1 at power unit (sample)
points.deenergize: Sample text: stop pump, close HV-1
points.stored_energy: Sample text: open accumulator bleed valve until gauge reads 0
points.verify: Sample text: accumulator gauge at 0 PSI

points.label: S-1
points.device: Steam supply ball valve SV-2 above machine (sample)
points.stored_energy: Sample text: open drain valve downstream, allow to cool
points.verify: Sample text: drain flow stopped, line cool to touch with gloves

points.label: M-1
points.deenergize: Sample text: lower platen fully before isolating hydraulics
points.lock: Install two safety blocks; lock blocks with chain lock
points.verify: Sample text: blocks seated on both sides

points.label: T-1
points.device: Die heater breaker HB-1 in control panel (sample)
points.stored_energy: Sample text: allow die to cool below 110 °F
points.verify: Sample text: check die temperature with IR thermometer

points.label: C-1
points.device: Adhesive supply valve at glue unit (sample)
points.verify: Sample text: no flow at applicator when purge is attempted
points.photo_missing_reason: Sample: photo to be taken at next shutdown

points.label: SS-1
points.verify: Sample text: press START to confirm machine does not run; return to OFF
